show.description: Devika thought she had found love, only to discover her husband, Vikrant, was a prince who conspired to destroy her unborn child. Brutalized by his lawful wife and carrying the bloodline of an enemy who wiped out her village, Devika was forced to embrace her identity as a powerful Naag Kanya. As ancient curses flared, she watched her betrayers rot from within, proving that no one escapes the bite of karma.
